basic_info.description: 422-424 Funston Avenue is a spacious, light-filled duplex in the Inner Richmond District. Both units will be delivered vacant. The top floor unit recently received a buyout.  422 Funston Ave (lower flat, 1,300 sq/ft) is a 2 bedroom-1 bath flat with a sunroom, living room, and dining room. The kitchen has been updated. 424 Funston Ave (upper unit, 1,966 sq/ft) is a 3 bedroom-2 bath, two-level unit. The top floor   "observation room" was added in 1923. This level has a bedroom, a full bathroom, is detached on four sides, and collects excellent natural light.    The building sits on a generous 120 ft. deep lot with a lovely, manicured rear yard. The garage has been retrofitted with a steel beam to allow two cars to park side-by-side or three cars in tandem. The back of the garage has bonus space that could be used as a laundry room, gym, office, or storage.    422-424 Funston Avenue is a perfect opportunity for partners, owners-occupiers, or developers looking to put the finishing touches on this home.
